AudioStrategy.description:
First-class native-audio strategy. Story-level ONLY — NO per-Moment volume
automation, NO clip ids (those are Edit Planner / audio-mix). Exact ducking,
fades and mixing belong downstream.

guidance.description: optional one concise semantic line, e.g. 'step back so the real guitar lands'
guidance.title: Guidance

AudioStrategy.title: AudioStrategy

EnergyArcRegion.description:
One APPROXIMATE Story-level energy region. Fractions are 0..1 of
target_duration_seconds — approximate regions, NEVER cut points.

label.description: short human-readable region name, e.g. 'warm gradual build'
label.title: Label

note.description: optional one-line creative intent for the region
note.title: Note

EnergyArcRegion.title: EnergyArcRegion

EnergyIntensity.description: Categorical direction of an energy_arc region — NO numeric energy scores.
EnergyIntensity.title: EnergyIntensity

MusicCharacter.description:
RESOLVED snapshot of the intended musical feel. Authority is
MusicDirection; this is carried for provenance / to seed track selection.
Do NOT treat as a second source of truth for mood/energy.
MusicCharacter.title: MusicCharacter

MusicPlanProvenance.description: How this plan was produced — recorded by the server/engine, not the model.

inputs.description: which inputs were actually fed (e.g. creative_intent, music_direction, story_guide, story_coverage)
inputs.title: Inputs

MusicPlanProvenance.title: MusicPlanProvenance

NativeAudioPriority.description:
How much room the Story's OWN captured audio needs (a guitar performance,
singing, laughter, dialogue, wind, waves, crowd).
NativeAudioPriority.title: NativeAudioPriority

SoundtrackRole.description: How much the composed soundtrack carries the Story vs native audio.
SoundtrackRole.title: SoundtrackRole

TrackSelectionCriteria.description:
OPTIONAL brief handle for a FUTURE track selector (M-d). The seam between
music intelligence and track sourcing — carries no catalog/provider assumption.
TrackSelectionCriteria.title: TrackSelectionCriteria

description:
FROZEN Story-level soundtrack shape (Milestone M-b). The intelligence
bridge from Story understanding to the future Edit Planner. Scope-sensitive:
an 8s Story = ONE energy region, a rich 60-120s Story may justify 3-4. NO
mechanical quiet->build->climax. Server/engine mints provenance/version.

energy_arc.description: SMALL, scope-sensitive sequence of approximate energy regions
energy_arc.title: Energy Arc

target_duration_seconds.description: the arc fractions are of THIS duration
target_duration_seconds.title: Target Duration Seconds

track_selection_criteria.description: optional handoff to a FUTURE track selector (M-d)

title: MusicPlan
